name: app-dark-rock-tablet-and-flight-booking-phones
title: Dark Flight Booking Phones and Rock Tablet
whatItIs: A slate page with a tablet resting on rock, a torn-paper 'Flight Booking Flow' banner, and three tilted dark phones showing search, flight details and bookings.
whatItMeans: Rock adds a rugged natural texture to a dark UI, and the fanned phones show the sequence.
techniques: Real rock as a device stand
Torn brush banner as a section title
Fanned overlapping phones at different tilts
Dark UI with blue gradient buttons

vocabulary.definition: Devices overlapped and rotated like a hand of cards.
A rough paint-stroke shape behind a title.
A rock or plant used to stage a device.
